# contextforge_gateway (Data Source)

Data source for looking up a ContextForge gateway by ID



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Gateway ID for lookup

### Read-Only

- `auth_header_key` (String) Custom authentication header key
- `auth_header_value` (String, Sensitive) Custom authentication header value
- `auth_headers` (List of Map of String, Sensitive) List of authentication header maps
- `auth_password` (String, Sensitive) Authentication password
- `auth_query_param_key` (String) Authentication query parameter key
- `auth_query_param_value` (String, Sensitive) Authentication query parameter value
- `auth_query_param_value_masked` (String) Masked authentication query parameter value
- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) Authentication token
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type
- `auth_username` (String) Authentication username
- `auth_value` (String, Sensitive) Generic authentication value
- `capabilities` (Dynamic) Gateway capabilities as a dynamic object
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `created_by` (String) User who created the gateway (read-only metadata)
- `created_from_ip` (String) IP address of creator (read-only metadata)
- `created_user_agent` (String) User agent of creator (read-only metadata)
- `created_via` (String) Creation method (read-only metadata)
- `description` (String) Gateway description
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the gateway is enabled
- `federation_source` (String) Federation source (read-only metadata)
- `import_batch_id` (String) Import batch identifier (read-only metadata)
- `last_refresh_at` (String) Last gateway refresh timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `last_seen` (String) Last seen timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `modified_by` (String) User who last modified the gateway (read-only metadata)
- `modified_from_ip` (String) IP address of last modifier (read-only metadata)
- `modified_user_agent` (String) User agent of last modifier (read-only metadata)
- `modified_via` (String) Modification method (read-only metadata)
- `name` (String) Gateway name
- `oauth_config` (Dynamic, Sensitive) OAuth configuration as a dynamic object
- `owner_email` (String) Owner email address
- `passthrough_headers` (List of String) Headers to pass through to the gateway
- `reachable` (Boolean) Whether the gateway is reachable
- `refresh_interval_seconds` (Number) Gateway automatic refresh interval in seconds
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly slug (read-only metadata)
- `tags` (List of String) Gateway tags
- `team` (String) Team name
- `team_id` (String) Team ID
- `transport` (String) Transport protocol (e.g., SSE, HTTP)
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `url` (String) Gateway URL endpoint
- `version` (Number) Version number (read-only metadata)
- `visibility` (String) Visibility setting (public, private, etc.)
